chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from al-Qāsim ibn Muhammad, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:

ʿUmar ibn Yazīd came to me and said to me, “Ride.” So I rode with him, and we went until we came to the house of Ḥafṣ al-Kunāsī. I brought him out, and he rode with us. Then we went on until we came to al-Gharī, and we came to a grave. He said, “Get down; this is the grave of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.” We said, “How did you know that?” He said, “I came to it with Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام while he was in al-Ḥīrah more than once, and he informed me that it is his grave.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحِيرَةِ: al-Ḥīrah, the place from which the Imam visited the grave
key_terms.الْغَرِيَّ: Al-Gharī, the location where the grave was visited
key_terms.خَبَّرَنِي: he informed me; indicating transmitted knowledge
key_terms.قَبْرُ: grave; the burial place being identified

ai.seo_question: How was the grave of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام identified according to al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a visit to the grave of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام at al-Gharī. The identification of the grave is based on the direct report of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, showing the transmission of knowledge of sacred locations through the Imams عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘Umar Bin Yazeed came over to me and said to me, ‘Ride’. So I rode with him, and we went until we came to the house of Hafs Al-Kunasy, So we got him out, and he rode with us. Then we went until we came over to Al-Ghary, so we ended up to a grave. So he said, ‘Descend! This is the grave of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>’. So we said, ‘From where did you know that?’ So he said, ‘I came to it along with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> when he<sup>asws</sup> was at Al-Hira, more than once, and he<sup>asws</sup> informed me that it is his<sup>asws</sup> grave’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from ‘Abdallah ibn Sinan who has said the following.

“Once ‘Umar ibn yazid came to me and said, “Ride with us and rode with them and went until we came to the house of Hafs al-Kunasi. He took him also with us and we continued the journey until we arrived at al-Ghari and to the grave. He said, “dismount, this is the grave of Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.).” We asked him, “How did you find out?” He said, “I have come here several times with abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) when he was in al-Hira and he told me that this is his (Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) grave.”
